strategyName: ZenBlade Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim v2

currentObservation.backtestResult: pending run in Replit or another environment with OKX network access

lastDecision: Create a focused v2 research script that isolates the only v1 component with positive gross PnL: sweep followed by VWAP reclaim or rejection. Do not touch Railway paper loop. Do not integrate unless v2 shows positive gross and net PnL after fees/slippage, PF around or above 1.1, controlled drawdown, and at least reasonable symbol/session robustness.

priorFindingFromV1.interpretation: There may be a weak gross edge in sweep -> VWAP reclaim/rejection, but v1 was not strong enough after fees/slippage. V2 should test narrower side, symbol, and session subsets without increasing trade frequency.

researchHypothesis.type: focused session-based sweep and VWAP reclaim/rejection strategy
researchHypothesis.primaryIdea: Wait for a liquidity sweep outside the session opening range, then enter only if price reclaims or rejects VWAP with volume/impulse confirmation.
whyDifferentFromV1: Removes broad ORB breakout and ORB retest scenarios
Focuses only on the setup that had positive gross PnL in v1
Starts with ETH and BTC only
Tests ETH-only, late-US-only, long-only, and short-only variants
Keeps low trade frequency and strict risk controls
riskControls: one trade per session per symbol
cooldown day after a losing trade

knownProblems: V1 edge was weak and disappeared after fees/slippage
V2 subsets may overfit the small 5m sample
ETH-only or side-only variants may not generalize
Crypto session definitions are imperfect because crypto trades 24/7
Backtest has not been run yet in this branch
blockedChanges: Do not add Session ORB VWAP v2 to Railway paper loop yet
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not use martingale or increase position size after losses
Do not claim success if only gross PnL is positive but net PnL remains negative
Do not expand to illiquid altcoins before ETH/BTC show edge

successCriteriaForFirstPass.minimumTrades: at least 20 trades preferred; fewer can be reviewed but not integrated
successCriteriaForFirstPass.tradesPerDay: low frequency preferred, ideally below 6 across the tested basket
successCriteriaForFirstPass.drawdown: controlled and ideally below 12% of 1000 USDT paper balance
successCriteriaForFirstPass.paperLoopDecision: if v2 remains net negative after fees/slippage, do not add to paper loop

nextResearch: Run npm run research:session-orb-vwap-v2 on Replit or local environment with OKX network access
Check whether any subset has positive gross and net PnL after fees/slippage
Compare long-only versus short-only and ETH-only versus BTC/ETH basket
Only after a strong result, run robustness checks before considering a disabled-by-default paper module
